question: List all products in the household category
sql: SELECT name, unit_price FROM products WHERE category = 'household'

question: How many customers are in each segment?
sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY segment ORDER BY n DESC

question: Which orders were placed in January 2025?
sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-02-01'

question: Average quantity per order line
sql: SELECT AVG(quantity) AS avg_qty FROM order_items

question: Count of completed vs cancelled orders
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY n DESC

question: total revenue by country, highest first
sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 200

question: units sold per product category
sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items AS oi INNER JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 200

question: What are the top 5 products by revenue?
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many orders were returned?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS returned_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'returned' LIMIT 200

question: What is the average order value by customer segment?
sql: SELECT c.segment, AVG(order_total) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id) AS order_totals JOIN customers AS c ON order_totals.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment LIMIT 200

question: What is the monthly revenue trend for 2025?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) ORDER BY month LIMIT 200

question: What is the revenue share by product category?
sql: SELECT category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / (SELECT SUM(oi2.quantity * oi2.unit_price) FROM order_items AS oi2) AS revenue_share FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue_share DESC LIMIT 200

question: Which customer spent the most?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many unique customers placed orders in 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS unique_customers FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01' LIMIT 200

question: What is the revenue or number of orders from customers in Kenya who bought electronics?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.country = 'Kenya' AND p.category = 'electronics' LIMIT 200

question: Who are the 5 most recently signed-up customers?
sql: SELECT customer_id, name, segment, country, signed_up FROM customers ORDER BY signed_up DESC LIMIT 5

question: How much revenue was lost to cancelled orders?
sql: SELECT SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price) AS lost_revenue FROM orders JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id WHERE orders.status = 'cancelled' LIMIT 200

question: What is the total number of units sold per product category?
sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM order_items AS oi INNER JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC LIMIT 200

question: What are the top 5 products by total revenue?
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which customer spent the most on completed orders?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which customers in Kenya bought electronics?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.country = 'Kenya' AND p.category = 'electronics' AND o.status = 'completed' ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 200

question: Which customer spent the most in total across completed orders?

question: What is the total revenue lost from cancelled orders?

question: Which customers in Kenya purchased electronics?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.country = 'Kenya' AND p.category = 'electronics' ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 200

question: How much revenue was lost to cancelled orders in 2025?
sql: SELECT SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price) AS lost_revenue FROM orders JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id WHERE orders.status = 'cancelled' AND orders.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND orders.order_date < '2026-01-01' LIMIT 200

question: What is the total units sold per product category?
sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM order_items AS oi INNER JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id INNER JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC LIMIT 200

question: monthly revenue trend for 2025
sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) AS month, SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id WHERE orders.status = 'completed' AND STRFTIME('%Y', orders.order_date) = '2025' GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) ORDER BY month LIMIT 200
